name: GxpTrainingMatrixManager
tagline: Role curricula, SOP read-and-understand and live GMP qualification status – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete GxP training and qualification app for pharmaceutical sites: employee × curriculum training matrix, assignment register, qualification board and compliance dashboard. Records read-and-understand e-signatures with signature meaning, enforces assessment pass marks and four-eyes verification of on-the-job training and qualifications, raises retraining waves when an SOP is revised, and shows live who is restricted from GMP tasks because a critical item is overdue or expired.
features: Training compliance vs target, overdue ageing, 8-week due/expiry outlook
Employee × curriculum matrix with 9 cell states and SOP-revision markers
Qualified / Retraining due / In training / Restricted derived from GMP-critical items
Assessment pass mark with failed-attempt history
Due-date extensions with limits and rationale
SOP revision → retraining wave or editorial version bump
Assign a whole role curriculum to a new starter
Bulk start, trainer, extend, remind, export
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
